description: How a prop moved from open to now. Use it to answer "has <player>'s line moved?" or "which way is the money going?". Give a prop_id for one prop, or a player (optionally stat or event_id) for all of that player's props. Returns open and current line and prices, line_move in stat units, line_direction, fair_over_move_pp (no-vig over probability shift in percentage points), price_direction and move counts.

event_id.description: One game's event_id from list_events. Without it, games from 6 hours ago onward are searched.

player.description: Player name or part of it, case-blind, for example "Adebayo".

stat.description: Stat market, lower case: points, rebounds, assists, threes, pra and the other markets FanDuel lists.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: line_move
